tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All Terms and Conditions as per Tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should not be blacklisted by any agency of the central government, Public Sector Undertaking or by any department of any State Government
All other document should be submit as per tender document

The bidder should have a minimum annual turnover of INR 50.00 lakhs from civil engineering consultancy services in any two of the last five financial years.(FY 2020-21 2021-22 2022-23 2023-24 & 2024-25)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Should have rendered consultancy services for at least one similar nature of completed works i.e, construction of cycling velodrome in a single entrustment costing not less than Rs.22.00 Lakhs in a period between 2020-21 to till date of submission of bid anywhere in India
